title: Arrival at the Collegium
introNarration: A sturdy hedgehog in a worn porter's coat steps out from the lanterns, whistle on a leather cord, quills neat as a roll-call. Blue lanterns hang in the oak like cold glass stars, and the mossy well at the roots waits with a bucket for anyone who has been practicing too hard. Porter Bramble names the first words: look, then help.
reminderNarration: Porter Bramble stays at your side until Arrival is finished. The lanterns still drift. The well is still cold. Type look, say hello, take key, then north to the Great Hall.

objectives.label: Look around Lantern Court. Type look to see Lantern Court.
Say hello so Porter knows you arrived.
Take the Small Copper Key from Porter. Type take key.
Type north to reach the Great Hall.
